svg.title: Investigation desk and tooling occupy three columns
svg.desc: Maintain investigation and creator columns while inserting a narrower tooling column without a room. Three roles share the page but keep distinct evidence and production surfaces.

**Frame:** Recto. [Page 085](085.md)'s split returns and a third column is cut into it, narrower than
the other two. Left: the investigators. Centre: the desk. Right: the tooling surface from
[page 086](086.md), still without a room.

**Action:** The mirror acquires the panel it was missing.

**Caption:**
> THE MIRROR ON PAGE 085 HAD TWO SIDES. THE APPARATUS DRAWING IT HAD THREE.

**Provenance:** `inferred` — the composition is the project's; the third lane is
`CI-REFUSAL` and the repository's own commit record.

", "title": "Investigation desk and tooling occupy three columns" } }
